title: Best Software Testers and QA Experts (2026): How to Hire One
h1: Best Software Testers and QA Experts
description: How to hire a software tester or QA expert: what testing should include, how to brief it, what drives the price and the red flags.
intro: A tester uses your website or app the way real users will, and finds the problems before they do. Independent testing is especially useful when the same developer who built something has only tested it themselves. Testing goes wrong when nobody explains what the product should do, bugs are reported vaguely, or testers get access to live customer data. This guide shows you how to get useful results.

faq.q: What is the difference between manual and automated testing?
faq.a: Manual testers click through the product like a user and catch confusing or broken behavior. Automated tests are code that checks the same things repeatedly. Small projects usually start with manual testing.
The ones your users have. Check your analytics for the most common phones, browsers and screen sizes, and share the list with the tester.

faq.q: What should a bug report contain?
faq.a: Steps to reproduce, what happened, what should have happened, the device and browser, and a screenshot or video. Ask for reports in this format.

faq.q: Should testers use my live site?
faq.a: Prefer a test copy with fake data. If testing must happen live, use test accounts and avoid real payments and real customer data.

faq.q: Can the tester fix the bugs?
faq.a: Usually not. Testers find and report; developers fix. After fixes, ask the tester to confirm them.
